objective: Reduce false strong cross-material Relation proposals and their audit cost without weakening semantic publication gates or suppressing valid strong relations across domains.

allowed: Add domain-neutral type and direction contracts for SUPPORTS, REQUIRES and DERIVED_FROM to RELATION_DETECT_SYSTEM.
Add generic negative examples for co-occurrence, definition-to-detail, partial support and shared-attribute/different-subject errors.
Clarify that a rejected strong edge may become RELATED_TO only if it independently meets navigation-utility requirements.
forbidden: Source IDs, benchmark question IDs or answer labels in prompts or ranking.
Llama-, model-card- or AI-specific production heuristics.
Using downstream audit verdicts as runtime detector inputs.
Relaxing Relation semantic audit, type critic, evidence resolution or publication fail-closed behavior.
Changing candidate retrieval, publication budgets or post-audit compaction in this intervention.

evaluationOrder: Run the frozen 10-case cross-domain calibration without labels in prompts.
If calibration passes, replay detection for frozen source s200-ai-llama-004 against the same v10 claims and candidate retrieval state.
If detector gates pass, semantically audit every replay candidate in an isolated workspace with no canonical publication writes.
Only after offline gates pass may a maximum four-source online canary run.

decisionRules.calibrationFails: Reject prompt intervention; do not run frozen-source semantic audit.
decisionRules.calibrationPassesButFrozenSourceCostFail: Keep diagnosis, reject intervention, and evaluate a separately contracted pre-audit type router.
decisionRules.offlinePassesButOnlineRegresses: Revert production prompt and retain only experimental reports.
decisionRules.allGatesPass: Accept the detector type-contract change and freeze the resulting prompt version.

interpretationLimits: The v10 model audit is diagnostic evidence, not human gold; manual review of all 23 SUPPORTS candidates supplies the frozen false-positive judgment for that source.
The calibration set is intentionally small and cross-domain. Passing it establishes guardrails, not general Relation quality.
This Goal optimizes proposal precision and cost, not answer-level Graph utility.
